context: Evaluates correct use of the AI trading decision execution function from open-nof1.ai. The solution must call the run() function with initial capital, which orchestrates market data fetching, DeepSeek model invocation with structured Zod schema output, and Prisma database persistence of Chat and Trading records.

checklist.name: Function call with capital
checklist.description: The solution correctly calls the trading execution function (run) from open-nof1.ai with a numeric initialCapital parameter

checklist.name: Structured output schema
checklist.description: The solution correctly handles the structured output schema with opeartion (Buy/Sell/Hold), optional buy (pricing, amount, leverage), optional sell (percentage), optional adjustProfit (stopLoss, takeProfit), and chat fields

checklist.name: Leverage constraint
checklist.description: Buy decisions correctly enforce leverage between 1 and 20 (inclusive) as specified by the Zod schema min/max constraints

checklist.name: Sell percentage constraint
checklist.description: Sell decisions correctly enforce percentage between 0 and 100 as specified by the Zod schema

checklist.name: Database persistence
checklist.description: The solution correctly persists the trading decision to the database creating Chat and associated Trading records via Prisma

checklist.name: DeepSeek model usage
checklist.description: The solution uses the DeepSeek reasoning model (deepseekR1 or deepseek) from the open-nof1.ai model configuration for generating the trading decision
